editorial:
Imagine trying to turn your life around with the person you love, only to have your whole world ripped away in a second. That is exactly what happens to Shelby. After fighting addiction, he finds his fiancée, Ruby, dead on their porch. Instead of calling the police and waiting for a trial, he decides to take matters into his own hands. You get to watch him go on a wild, angry rampage through a small town, taking out drug dealers one by one. It feels like a gritty street fight from start to finish, and the vibe is mostly raw anger and pure chaos.

What really makes this one pop is the choice of weapon. Seeing a guy use a nail gun to clear out a room of criminals is way more interesting than just another movie with guns. The action moves quickly, though some of the side characters feel a bit flat. If you love movies where a regular guy becomes a one-man army, you will dig this.
endingExplained: After a bloody trail of bodies, Shelby finally faces off against the crime boss, Coyote. In a brutal final fight, Shelby uses his nail gun to get the ultimate revenge for Ruby's death. He manages to kill Coyote, ending the drug ring's grip on the town. Sheriff Church eventually catches up to him, but the cycle of violence is over. Shelby finds a dark kind of peace knowing the people who ruined his life are gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and gritty action movies.
